title: Degree of a partition polynomial
statement: Let $p$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, let $z$ be a point of that cube, and let $\\pi:[n]\\to[m]$ be any map. The partition polynomial formed from $p$, $z$, and $\\pi$ has Fourier degree at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function p on the Boolean cube
A point z in the Boolean cube
A map from the n coordinates to the m coordinates
A natural number k such that the Fourier degree of p is at most k
